sec: FGF23 actions, PTH vs vitamin D table and vitamin D assay · p872

items.q: FGF23 is beneficial because of P excretion but harmful because it:
items.exp: FGF23 harmful as it (−) vit D; beneficial d/t P excretion. (Book p872)

items.q: Match FGF23 actions — 1) Na-P cotransporter type 2a (PCT)  2) 1α-hydroxylase  3) PTH … A) (−) via Klotho receptor (lost in CKD d/t Klotho resistance)  B) (−) → ↓ vit D  C) (−) → phosphaturic
items.exp: FGF23 inhibits the Na-P cotransporter (phosphaturic), 1α-hydroxylase (↓vit D) and PTH via Klotho (not seen in CKD due to Klotho resistance). (Book p872)

items.q: Match PTH vs vitamin D on the kidney — 1) PTH  2) Vitamin D … A) ↓ Ca/P excretion (by 25(OH)D3 & 1,25(OH)2D3)  B) ↑ Ca reabsorption and ↑ P excretion
items.exp: PTH ↑ Ca reabsorption & ↑ P excretion; vit D ↓ Ca/P excretion. (Book p872)

items.q: On bone, intermittent LOW doses of PTH cause:
items.exp: PTH normally ↑ resorption (mobilises Ca); intermittent low doses ↑ bone formation. (Book p872)

items.q: Match vitamin D metabolite to bone effect — 1) 1,25(OH)2 D3  2) 24,25(OH)2 D3 … A) ↑ bone formation  B) ↑ bone resorption
By the Endocrine Society of India, a vitamin D level <12 ng/ml (deficient) is treated with:
opts: 50,000 IU per week for 6–8 weeks, maintenance 600–2000 IU/day
items.exp: Deficient: 50000 IU/week ×6–8 wks, maintenance 600–2000 IU/day. (Book p872)

items.q: Vitamin D insufficiency (12–19 ng/ml) is managed with at least:
The RDA of vitamin D is 600 IU till 70 years and ___ after 70 years.
items.exp: RDA 600 IU till 70 yrs; 800 IU after 70 yrs. (Book p872)

items.q: When hydroxylation is impaired, the active drug and maintenance dose are:
opts: Calcitriol 0.25–0.5 µg/day; maintenance 0.25 µg every alternate day
items.exp: Hydroxylation impaired → calcitriol 0.25–0.5 µg/day; maintenance 0.25 µg alternate day. (Book p872)
